name: Jelly Trip
author: Addicting Games
description: Jelly Trip is a puzzle game based on the colorful and wondrous jellyfish of the sea. Travel deep into the sea to find a row of beautifully colored jellyfish that are eager to return with their family. Help them out by clicking and dragging a row horizontally to match together 3 or more of the same color. While this is a casual game, there is a timer meaning you must match the right amount of jellyfish before it runs out. There are 16 levels of this matching game for you to play! No tutorial is needed for this simple game. Just click and drag to create 3 or more groups of jellyfish. When you have solved all 16 levels, head over to the high scores board to see if you made it! Challenge your friends to beat your score on this puzzle game.
